What Are Replica 3 Title Presets? / ˈrepləkə /

Replica 3 Title Presets is a collection of 81 made for video editors who demand visual identity.

These are ready-to-use text animations packed with style — not templates you have to rebuild.

They include built-in fonts, a variety of styles, and full control over color, scale, timing, and layout.
